summary: Tested inline ED & RH message edit feature end-to-end on React app at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All 10 scenarios from the review request passed: defaults render, pencil opens editor with prefilled values, save persists to localStorage and updates read view, Reset text appears and restores defaults + removes LS key, reload hydrates persisted text, Cancel discards changes without LS write, photo change/reset regression works, login BM-2024-001/budgetmitra reaches dashboard and logout returns to login, fonts Manrope+Sora active. Emblem animation float-emblem is defined on .rupee-badge parent (not the img); feature verified via CSS inspection.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js is growing; consider extracting the LeadershipCard/MessageEditor into its own component for maintainability if it exceeds ~700 lines.
saveEditMsg trims fields but does not enforce max length — extremely long input could be persisted to localStorage (5MB cap) with no user feedback. Consider a soft limit + inline warning.
localStorage writes are wrapped in try/catch but silent — a subtle failure (private mode, quota) would leave the UI showing edited copy that vanishes on reload. Consider a toast on write failure.
seed_data_creation: None. localStorage cleared at test start; test payloads written & cleaned up by reset flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Inline edit feature stable. Key testids: edit-ed-message-button, ed-message-editor, edit-heading-input, edit-body1-input, edit-body2-input, edit-signature-input, save-edit-message-button, cancel-edit-message-button, reset-ed-message-button, ed-heading, ed-body1, ed-body2, ed-signature. LocalStorage key: bm_ed_msg (JSON) and bm_ed_photo (data URL). Photo input uses [data-testid=ed-photo-input] with setInputFiles.
